We’ve pitted an ultra-high-tech plug-in hybrid supercar against a heavy-hitting, twin-motor family hauler to see if instant EV torque can outrun pure Italian pedigree! It’s the Ferrari 296 taking on the all-new Porsche Cayenne EV!

Can thousands of pounds of luxury SUV really hold off Maranello's finest off the line? Let’s check out the stats…

Starting with the Ferrari 296, it’s powered by a 3.0-litre twin-turbo V6 mid-engined hybrid setup, pumping out a staggering 830hp and 740Nm of torque. All that power is sent strictly to the rear wheels via an 8-speed automatic gearbox, and thanks to built-in launch control, it squeezes every bit of performance out of its sleek 1,640kg body. It’s an absolute engineering masterpiece, but perfection doesn't come cheap, this beauty will set you back £279,343!
